description: This file defines FastAPI route endpoints related to user authentication, user registration, and CRUD operations for notes, including security with JWT tokens and database interactions.

methods.name: User get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves the current user based on JWT token authentication.

methods.name: register(user: models.UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, returning user info.

methods.name: login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns a JWT access token.

methods.name: me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns information about the current authenticated user.

methods.name: create_note(note: models.NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new note for the currently logged-in user.

methods.name: list_notes(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists notes belonging to the current user.

methods.name: get_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific note by ID for the current user.

methods.name: update_note(note_id: int, note_update: models.NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates the title or content of a specific note for the current user.

methods.name: delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a specific note belonging to the current user.
